1a.decision: The source explicitly labels (±)-1a; an unassigned graph is not treated as achiral. Registry chirality_status is racemic and representation_status is partial.

3a.decision: The source states (R)-3a, but the candidate SMILES does not encode the absolute tetrahedral configuration; chirality_status is specified and representation_status is partial.

limitations: Graph diagnostics cannot infer unreported configuration, ee, dr, or racemic composition.
RDKit axial/allene diagnostics are limited; source text and drawings control the registry status.
Parsing a candidate SMILES does not verify its source transcription.
